prompt: Build a carriage that slides on a rail. Make a part Rail: a 200 × 20 × 10 mm bar (X × Y × Z) with one corner at its origin. Make a part Carriage: a 30 × 20 × 15 mm block with one corner at its origin. Place the rail as instance Track, grounded, and the carriage as instance Slide. Join them with a slider joint so the carriage sits on top of the rail, flush with its sides (the same Y range), can slide only along X without turning, and starts with its near end 50 mm from the rail's end at x = 0. Use a joint, not a hand-computed placement.
